title: Routine
description: A user-defined routine: an ordered list of steps, optionally attached to a trigger and a day/time schedule. See docs/SPEC.md §4.

name.description: Not explicitly bounded in docs/SPEC.md §4; capped here as a sanity limit (Step.name is the spec-mandated ≤50).

start_time.description: 24-hour local time, HH:MM. Null for flexible routines, which have no start time — same treatment as the nullable trigger_id and deleted_at above.

step_ids.description: Ordered list of Step IDs belonging to this routine.

updated_at.description: Bump on every write. Sync conflict resolution is last-writer-wins by this field — see docs/SPEC.md §5.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker. Never hard-delete routines — see docs/SPEC.md §5.
